markdown:
Authentic avocado oil is produced by cold-pressing or centrifuging the de-pitted flesh of ripe avocados
Major global and domestic manufacturers supply 100% pure culinary and cosmetic grade oils, ranging from large international exporters in Mexico and the US to certified bulk producers and private-label suppliers in India
